zh.title: 雷虎科技董事長陳冠如：無人機是消耗品不是藝術品，大量生產能力決定戰場供應
zh.summary: 雷虎科技董事長陳冠如接受中央社專訪表示，無人機已從精緻裝備變成戰場消耗品，關鍵不在做到完美，而在大量生產與成本控制；雷虎已取得美國Blue UAS Cleared認證，並與美國夥伴爭取美國國防部無人機優勢計畫訂單。
body: 陳冠如接受中央社專訪時表示，俄烏戰爭自2022年2月開打迄今已逾4年半，無人機長程攻擊已成為延續戰局的主角，戰爭正朝消耗戰的方向發展。他認為，無人機是消耗品、不是藝術品，先求有，再求好，現階段最需要的是能夠大量生產的無人機種。
他說，投入軍用商規無人機產業，品質要求是「Just enough is the new perfect（恰到好處才是新的完美）」；控制無人機製造成本，才能維持穩定大量生產，充分供應戰場需求。像俄烏戰場消耗大量無人機，打的就是消耗戰，「以無人機的消耗取代戰士犧牲，並以低價無人機攔截高價導彈。」自殺式無人機與攻擊目標同歸於盡，更凸顯量產能力的重要。

雷虎已把研發與生產經驗複製到美國工廠，產品是「台灣研發、美國製造」；今年與美國AI軍工企業Shield AI簽約，將Hivemind自主化軟體整合至雷虎旗下無人系統產品組合，首波率先導入雷虎海鯊號無人艇平台。雷虎轉投資美國企業在俄亥俄州生產無人機，已取得美國頒發的Blue UAS Cleared認證，代表產品完全符合美國軍方嚴格的資安、法規與供應鏈安全標準，獲准列入美國國防採購清單；陳冠如指出，這是台灣無人機產業首家取得此認證，雷虎不但接獲台灣國防部訂單，更打入美國市場，取得美國國防部訂單。
美國國防部近年推動總額11億美元的無人機優勢計畫（Drone Dominance Program，簡稱DDP），目標在2027年前採購約33萬架低成本單程攻擊無人機，2026年5月選出最終階段5家廠商，雷虎與美國合作夥伴名列其中，未來將爭取第三、四階段的訂單機會。陳冠如認為，相較於半導體產業是台灣的護國神山，台灣無人機產業也是真正守護台灣的護國產業。

en.title: Thunder Tiger chairman: drones are consumables, not artworks — mass production is what the battlefield needs
en.summary: Thunder Tiger chairman Chen Kuan-ju told CNA that drones have become battlefield consumables, and the industry's decisive capability is now mass production at controlled cost; the company has earned the US Blue UAS Cleared certification and is pursuing US Department of Defense Drone Dominance Program orders with its American partners.
body: Chen Kuan-ju, chairman of Taiwanese drone maker Thunder Tiger, told Central News Agency in an interview that more than four and a half years into the Russia-Ukraine war, long-range drone strikes have become the mainstay sustaining the conflict, and warfare is moving toward attrition. "Drones are consumables, not artworks," he said — get them fielded first, then improve them — and what the battlefield needs most now is drone types that can be mass-produced.

For military-grade commercial drones, Chen said the quality bar is "Just enough is the new perfect." Controlling manufacturing cost is what keeps mass production stable and the battlefield supplied: in Ukraine, huge numbers of drones are being consumed in a war of attrition, "using drone consumption to replace soldiers' sacrifice, and cheap drones to intercept expensive missiles." One-way attack drones are destroyed together with their targets, which makes production volume decisive.

Thunder Tiger has replicated its research and production know-how at a US plant — "Taiwan R&D, US manufacturing" — and signed an agreement this year with US AI defence company Shield AI to integrate its Hivemind autonomy software into Thunder Tiger's unmanned systems, starting with the Sea Shark unmanned surface vessel platform. Its US investee manufactures drones in Ohio and has received the US Blue UAS Cleared certification, confirming the products meet strict US military cybersecurity, regulatory and supply-chain security standards and placing them on the US defence procurement list. Chen said Thunder Tiger is the first Taiwanese drone company to earn the certification, and it has won orders from both Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense and the US Department of Defense.

The US Department of Defense's Drone Dominance Program is an US$1.1 billion procurement and capability upgrade effort aiming to buy about 330,000 low-cost one-way attack drones by 2027; five finalists were selected in May 2026, including Thunder Tiger and its US partner, which will compete for phase-three and phase-four orders. Chen likened Taiwan's drone industry to the semiconductor sector's "sacred mountain" role, calling it an industry that truly protects Taiwan.

facts.claim: Chen Kuan-ju said drones are consumables, not artworks, and that the battlefield now needs drone types that can be mass-produced.
Thunder Tiger's US investee manufactures drones in Ohio and has received the US Blue UAS Cleared certification, making it the first Taiwanese drone company to earn it.

The US Drone Dominance Program totals US$1.1 billion and aims to procure about 330,000 low-cost one-way attack drones by 2027; Thunder Tiger and its US partner were among the five finalists selected in May 2026.
Thunder Tiger signed an agreement with Shield AI to integrate Hivemind autonomy software into its unmanned systems, starting with the Sea Shark platform.
Chen said the quality bar for military-grade commercial drones is 'Just enough is the new perfect,' and that cost control sustains mass production.
